## Licence note

Purchased parts appear as BOM lines only. No vendor CAD is copied into this package: `cad/`, `dxf/` and `stl/` hold the design's own custom parts. E3D's reference CAD (CC BY-NC-ND) is visible only as part of the whole-machine and stage pictures in `images/`, which are renders of the assembly.
